snippet.title: Toxic Yuri - TEASER TRAILER! 🦠
snippet.description:
Wishlist here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503300/Toxic_Yuri/

An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl in abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen.
